title: One evening's chat (example)

steps.label:
Whole prompt sent; Anthropic caches it
for an hour

Prompt identical: 85% of it read from
the cache at a tenth of the price
Cache still warm, still the cheap price

What Vana knows is rebuilt once;
the new prompt is cached again

example: On dev: about 0.8¢ a turn, down from 3.2¢;
85% of input from the cache, up from 43%.
